price_offset_note: Single DaryaGold price basis (owner t244u, 2026-11-21): DaryaGold = Dukascopy mid + mid_offset_usd (default 0.02, set by /offset or the /calibrate median; bot_state.state.dg_offset). Levels are built on Dukascopy bid bars, so the bid->DaryaGold offset is price_offset_usd = feed_spread_usd/2 + mid_offset_usd (0.175 + 0.02 = 0.195); load_config recomputes it. Older basis (until 2026-11-21): bid + 0.3 for levels, mid + 0.02 for the live price.
news_buffers_note: Single source of truth: tools/news_windows.py (effective_doc). Effective window = union of these floors (from the official release time) and the stored start/end in data/news_windows.json; never shrunk. Tier A and tier B are both no-entry blocks inside the effective window; for tier B be flat (positions closed, pending orders cancelled) before the effective start. Tier C is monitor only.

session.note: Owner 2026-11-21: DaryaGold market opens Monday 01:30 Tehran (Sunday 17:00 New York); each session runs 01:30 to 00:30 next day (daily break 00:30-01:30); the last session closes Saturday 00:30. Friday: no new setups from 23:30. Commands (/setup /trend /levels /e /brief) work whenever the market is open; the bot's automatic alerts and briefs run 07:00-00:30 only (alerts_from). The bot never closes anything; it only reminds the owner.

news_semantics: Single source of truth for DaryaGold news windows. Effective window = union of the stored data/news_windows.json start/end and event_time minus before_min / plus after_min. For tiers in news_block_tiers (A and B): no new entries and no pending orders from the effective start until the effective end, and any open position must be closed before the effective start. Example: US PPI 17:00 Tehran stored 16:45-17:15 -> no entries from 16:45 (not 16:50) to 17:15, close open trades before 16:45. Tier C is monitor only.
